new_statements.second_reader_evidence: Only one work was listed and it was opened; no silent/not-opened works to spot-check. As a substitute I spot-checked the two other sources already held by the project in the folder: HSAI 1946 has no stress/accent line anywhere near 'yanacona' (all ~20 hits are the Inca/colonial servile class or 'yanaconate'); Mincultura 2010 has no acento/prosodia/silaba term at all; its LENGUA section (p. 6-7) says 'Se considera que la lengua Yanacona, es una lengua muerta' with footnote 'Tambien conocida como Quechua' and 'Los yanaconas hoy en dia solo hablan espanol'. Nothing missed.
